description: This file defines the BordersRenderer class responsible for rendering Borders objects to RTF format within the MigraDoc document processing library. It includes methods for rendering borders with specific styles and positions, and manages border rendering for table cells and formats.

classes.name: BordersRenderer
classes.description: A class that renders Borders objects to RTF, handling individual border sides and diagonals, with control over whether to omit certain borders.

methods.name: BordersRenderer
methods.description: Constructor initializing the renderer with a DocumentObject and RtfDocumentRenderer.

methods.name: Render
methods.description: Main method to render the Borders object to RTF, processing each border side and diagonals.

methods.name: CreateBorderRenderer
methods.description: Creates a BorderRenderer for a specific border and border type, setting parent cell and format context.
